item.description:
Jot 0.8.0

Cleaner transcripts. Across your last ten meetings roughly one line in eight was Whisper echoing the glossary back over silence, or stock boilerplate like "Thank you for watching". This release removes that at the source and after the fact.

  • The language is pinned. Jot now tells the model which language to transcribe, so silent openings no longer come back as Swedish and Dutch speech no longer comes back in English. The default is Dutch (Context → General); each organization and each meeting can pick its own, including in the Manual Upload prompt.
  • Glossary echo and boilerplate are filtered out. Lines that are just the glossary ("TnT", "Caleidos", the notes sentence), outro and subtitle credits, bare URLs and symbol-only lines are dropped. Timestamps are untouched.
  • A leaner prompt. The context sent to the model is now a flat list of names and terms — no "Organization:" or "Meeting:" lines and no freeform notes, which were the most-echoed parts. Each recording part also carries the end of the previous part for continuity across splits.
  • Silence is trimmed before upload. A recorder left running before or after the meeting no longer feeds minutes of nothing to the model. Timestamps stay on the original recording clock.
  • You can see what happened. Each Audit Log row shows the language used and the share of lines filtered, e.g. · nl · 12% filtered, and the on-disk .json keeps the model's confidence fields. Retrying a failed meeting reuses the same language.

Worth doing after updating: add an organization for the companies that recur in your meetings, with their names and terms, and check the default language under Context → General.
